entries.speaker: Metaverse Navigator
entries.en: This is the return point for[n]Kamoshida's Palace.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, so we can go back to reality if we use[n]the Metaverse Nav here.
entries.uk: А, тобто тут можна повернутися в реальність[n]через Метанавігатор.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But we just came in. C'mon, let's look[n]for that Treasure thing.
entries.uk: Але ж ми щойно прийшли. Ну ж бо,[n]пошукаймо той Скарб.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, we just came in here.
entries.uk: Ну ж бо, ми ж щойно прийшли.

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, let's sneak in and look for that[n]Treasure thing!

entries.en: It seems we can return to the[n]real world if we decide to use the[n]Metaverse Nav here.

entries.en: However, it would be best[n]not to head back right now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's lookin' like this door still won't open.
entries.uk: Схоже, ці двері досі не відчиняються.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Didn't I tell you last time not to go in the[n]front too?
entries.uk: Хіба я минулого разу не казав не лізти[n]через головний вхід?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, I remember! Anyways, let's sneak[n]in the same way as last time!
entries.uk: Тьху, пам'ятаю! Коротше, прокрадімося[n]тим самим шляхом, що й минулого разу!

entries.en: It seems as though this[n]door won't open...
We should probably use[n]another way to sneak in...
